title: Welcome to WikiBlog
content:
This is a minimal dark-themed wiki-style blog. You can create links between articles using the [[Article Name]] syntax.

Try searching for articles using the search bar above. The search looks through both titles and content.

title: Getting Started
content:
To add more articles, simply edit the blogs.json file and add new entries.

Each article should have an id, title, content, and date. You can reference other articles like [[Welcome to WikiBlog]] to create wiki-style links.

title: Dark Theme Design
content:
This blog uses a minimal dark theme with carefully chosen colors for readability.

The design is clean and distraction-free, focusing on the content. Search functionality helps you find articles quickly.
